items.name: Eternal Luminosity
items.text: An anguished hellfire naturally sheds brilliant light like a torch. When other creatures target the anguished hellfire, they ignore the Concealed condition from darkness, fog, mist, and smoke.

items.name: Solar Flare
items.text: 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it takes 4d6 fire damage (DC 38 basic Fortitude save save). On a failed save, it also becomes Dazzled until the end of its next turn. The anguished hellfire can deactivate or activate this aura by using a single action that has the concentrate trait.

items.name: Vulnerable to Blasphemy
items.text: If a creature the anguished flame can see and hear spends 1 action with the linguistic trait blaspheming Asmodeus, the anguished flame becomes Sickened 1 until they Collect a Prayer from that creature.

items.name: Collect Unholy Prayer
items.text:
The anguished flame compels the prayers of a creature they can see within 60 feet, and that creature must attempt a DC 41 Will save save. A creature with the holy trait gets a degree of success one better than their result.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature uses its reaction to pray.

Failure The creature prays. It is Slowed 1 and can't use reactions for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is Slowed 2.

items.name: Focus Gaze
items.text:
Requirements The anguished hellfire's solar flare aura is active

---
Effect The anguished hellfire fixes their fiery eyes on a creature they can see within 30 feet. The target must immediately attempt a Fortitude save against the anguished hellfire's solar flare. If the creature was already Dazzled by solar flare before attempting its save, a failed save causes it to become Blinded until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Scourging Flame
items.text: The hellfire can burn away beneficial magic. It attempts a flaming wing Strike. On a success, the anguished hellfire attempts to counteract one spell effect of its choice active on the target. The counteract modifier is +36, and the counteract rank is 9th.
